name: How long does wall tile installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does wall tile installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wall tile installation project depends on several factors, including the size and complexity of the area, the type of tile, and the condition of the existing wall. A small bathroom backsplash might take 1-2 days, while a larger shower or accent wall could require 3-5 days. This estimate includes preparation, setting tiles, and grouting, allowing for necessary curing times between steps. We provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity, but a small backsplash might take 1-2 days, while a larger area could be 3-5 days.
